Looking at the error, the issue is that the code is trying to access year columns that don't exist in the dataframe. The table only has specific year columns (1991, 1995, 1996, etc.), not a continuous range from 1991 to 2013. The code needs to use only the actual year columns present in the dataframe.

~~~python
# Filter the row for Škoda Felicia
felicia_row = df[df['Model'] == 'Škoda Felicia']

# Get the actual year columns from the dataframe (excluding 'Model' and 'Total')
# These are all columns except the first one (Model) and potentially the last one (Total)
year_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col != 'Model' and col != 'Total']

# Get the values for Škoda Felicia across years, convert to numeric (coerce errors to NaN)
felicia_values = felicia_row[year_columns].replace('−', pd.NA).replace('', pd.NA).iloc[0].astype(float)

# Find the year with the minimum non-null value
min_year = felicia_values.idxmin()

# The question asks for the year, so we return the year as a string (or int)
answer = min_year
~~~
